correctness.rationale: The proof establishes the claim about geometric points of W. In the Finding the phrase 'every geometric point' refers to W, whose support is described immediately afterward; it cannot refer to all of B, whose ordinary geometric points have sequence (0,1,2,3). The Jacobian rank argument excludes singularities because p divides none of 2, 3, 5 or m(5−m) for 1≤m≤4. Adjunction yields the genus-four canonical complete intersection. Newton identities give h, with discriminant −200 and h(1)=10, so every repeated-coordinate point has exactly one repeated pair. Each transposition fixes six points and no point on its negative projective eigenspace; tame Riemann–Hurwitz gives quotient genus one, hence one invariant and three anti-invariant canonical differentials. In an anti-invariant local uniformizer their orders are respectively odd and even; an adapted basis has three distinct even orders, forcing positive weight. The generic order sequence is classical since degree 6
residual_risks: The result only concerns the stated power-sum model, not arbitrary twists, the whole-curve zeta function, or p≤5. The Finding's point quantifier should explicitly say 'of W'.

evidence: For each known involution with six fixed points on the smooth canonical genus-four curve, tame Riemann–Hurwitz gives 6=2(2g'−2)+6, hence g'=1. The invariant canonical dimension is 1, the anti-invariant dimension 3. At a fixed point three distinct even orders force an order ≥4. Since the series has degree 6<p, its 60 total ordinary weights must be exhausted by these 60 distinct fixed points. Over finite fields the 60 points are the normalized orderings of the separable cubic roots, so every orbit has the order of Frobenius on those roots.

On p≥11 even the explicit stall census in 09f9eec44d62 suffices for the weight-one conclusion by the same classical weight budget. The frozen claim supplies a valid self-contained derivation but does not isolate a substantive new remainder.

No independently useful exact remainder beyond these existing or mechanically implied facts is isolated; there is no repair based solely on clarifying the point quantifier or restating the same table.
